'].map(src=>{const im=new Image();im.src=src;return im;});
const palettes=[{top:'#99c548',lip:'#4c7c36',rock:'#716343',inside:'#51452f',stone:'#988763',outline:'#354b34'}, {top:'#ffd465',lip:'#c89038',rock:'#b87d39',inside:'#79542f',stone:'#d8a756',outline:'#76572e'}, {top:'#a3b4a6',lip:'#607b77',rock:'#536b71',inside:'#324d59',stone:'#75898a',outline:'#294650'}];
function biomeIndex(){return current===50?8:current<3?6:current<10?0:current<18?3:current<26?1:current<33?2:current<41?5:current<45?7:4;}
palettes.push({top:'#f0fcff',lip:'#9ddbeb',rock:'#73afc7',inside:'#386888',stone:'#b8e9f4',outline:'#304f73'}, {top:'#ffe7a0',lip:'#ce9b4e',rock:'#b79355',inside:'#756039',stone:'#dfc587',outline:'#574e34'}, {top:'#b5c3d2',lip:'#70879d',rock:'#52647b',inside:'#28364b',stone:'#8193a6',outline:'#182839'});
function polygon(points,color){ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.beginPath();points.forEach(([x,y],i)=>i?ctx.lineTo(x,y):ctx.moveTo(x,y));ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();}
function newEnvironment(biome){
const sky=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,540);sky.addColorStop(0,biome===3?'#244775':biome===4?'#393b49':'#111c30');sky.addColorStop(1,biome===3?'#b6e6ee':biome===4?'#b38d55':'#394764');ctx.fillStyle=sky;ctx.fillRect(0,0,viewW,540);
if(biome===3){
 ellipse(viewW*.78,96,42,42,'#e9f8eb');ellipse(viewW*.78-14,85,39,38,'#456d96');
 for(let layer=0;layer<3;layer++)for(let i=-1;i<viewW/220+2;i++){const x=i*250-(camX*(.025+layer*.018))%250,peak=120+layer*83+(i%3)*17;polygon([[x-140,540],[x+120,peak],[x+340,540]],['#759dbd','#5d8ba9','#3e6c87'][layer]);polygon([[x+51,peak+112],[x+120,peak],[x+187,peak+105],[x+143,peak+82],[x+112,peak+106],[x+96,peak+78]],['#d7eef4','#d0eaf1','#b9e2eb'][layer]);}
 for(let i=-1;i<viewW/100+1;i++){const x=i*115-(camX*.12)%115,y=470+(i%3)*17;line(x,y-85,x,y+65,'#2c4e66',8);for(let j=0;j<3;j++)polygon([[x-26-j*8,y-8+j*21],[x,y-91+j*24],[x+26+j*8,y-8+j*21]],j%2?'#4b8195':'#d8eef3');}
 for(let i=0;i<35;i++){const x=((i*131+Math.sin(clock*.25+i)*12)%viewW+viewW)%viewW,y=(i*77+clock*(8+i%9))%540;ellipse(x,y,1.3+i%2,1.3+i%2,'#f5ffffb0');}
}else{
 const temple=biome===4;ctx.strokeStyle=temple?'#dfbc7530':'#6a819c35';ctx.lineWidth=2;
 for(let row=0;row<9;row++){let y=row*66;line(0,y,viewW,y,ctx.strokeStyle);for(let x=-140+(row%2)*70;x<viewW;x+=140)line(x,y,x,y+66,ctx.strokeStyle);}
 for(let i=-1;i<viewW/290+1;i++){const x=i*290-(camX*.08)%290;
 if(temple){rr(x+60,65,105,390,45,'#253e4b');rr(x+76,80,73,360,31,'#396274');line(x+110,94,x+110,420,'#b6975366',3);for(let y=95;y<475;y+=51){rr(x+4,y,26,23,3,'#c2a15d');line(x+10,y+5,x+23,y+17,'#67603f',3);}rr(x-15,20,47,480,4,'#b69a61');rr(x-22,32,61,22,3,'#eed393');rr(x-22,440,61,25,3,'#eed393');for(let y=62;y<440;y+=55)line(x-10,y,x+26,y,'#7c713f',2);for(let y of [63,414]){rr(x-15,y,47,18,2,'#3b8990');for(let k=0;k<4;k++)rr(x-11+k*11,y+4,6,9,1,'#e3c56e');}}
 else{rr(x+70,60,108,220,50,'#132035');rr(x+81,72,86,196,40,'#496b88');for(let k=0;k<4;k++)line(x+90+k*21,84,x+90+k*21,265,'#1c3046',7);line(x+84,180,x+166,180,'#1c3046',7);polygon([[x-10,85],[x+45,85],[x+45,245],[x+17,224],[x-10,245]],'#913e51');polygon([[x+17,125],[x+30,150],[x+17,178],[x+4,150]],'#e5bb77');}
 const tx=x+215,ty=310;ellipse(tx,ty-18,42+Math.sin(clock*3+i)*3,60,temple?'#ffd47e13':'#ffa35b16');line(tx,ty,tx,ty+36,'#191f2f',7);ellipse(tx,ty-10,8,17+Math.sin(clock*7+i)*3,'#ec9950');ellipse(tx,ty-7,4,11,'#ffe9a4');
 }
 const fog=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,400,0,540);fog.addColorStop(0,'#17233300');fog.addColorStop(1,temple?'#dac18a55':'#13243bbb');ctx.fillStyle=fog;ctx.fillRect(0,400,viewW,140);
}
}
